name: Cuban Style Cheesy Chicken-Rice Skillet with Peas & Bell Peppers

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the skillet and cook, flipping once, until starting to brown, about 4 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Remove skillet from the heat and transfer chicken to a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and onions.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, seed, and small dice bell peppers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat; add the veggies, rice, broth, tomato paste, and spices. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp cumin
1 ½ tsp turmeric
1 ½ tsp oregano
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low. Return chicken to the skillet (overlapping the chicken thighs slightly, if necessary), cover, and cook until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
Place peas in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals.
Remove skillet from the heat. Sprinkle cheese and peas over the top, and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and rice between plates and enjoy!
